metadata.title: Student Learning Dashboard Human Usability Evaluation Protocol
metadata.scientific_disclaimer: Human usability evaluation framework. EXP-009 validates software and interface invariants. EXP-012 defines the human usability instrument. If no real participant data is provided, status remains NOT_RUN (HUMAN_DATA_REQUIRED). Zero participant responses are manufactured.
metadata.ethical_notice: Requires institutional ethical approval / IRB clearance and informed consent prior to human data collection.

tasks.name: Locate Specific Academic Concept
tasks.prompt: Locate the concept 'Convolution' on the knowledge map or list view.
tasks.success_criteria: Student selects and inspects the correct concept node within 60 seconds.

tasks.name: Interpret Estimated Knowledge and Confidence
tasks.prompt: Explain what the displayed 'Estimated knowledge' (0.75) and 'Evidence confidence' (0.80) mean for this concept.
tasks.success_criteria: Student correctly identifies that estimates reflect latent probabilistic inference rather than absolute cognition.

tasks.name: Comprehend Recommended Learning Action
tasks.prompt: Identify the top recommendation and explain why this action was prioritized.
tasks.success_criteria: Student correctly cites the underlying reason code (e.g., prerequisite deficit or weakness).

tasks.name: Trace Evidence Provenance to Source Document
tasks.prompt: Inspect the supporting evidence drawer and identify the textbook chapter/chunk grounding the concept.
tasks.success_criteria: Student navigates to the source chunk reference successfully.

tasks.name: Compare Graph View and List View Usability
tasks.prompt: Toggle between Graph View and List View to inspect prerequisite dependencies.
tasks.success_criteria: Student completes navigation across both views.

likert_items.statement: I could find the concept I was looking for.
I understood why a recommendation was shown.
I could identify the source supporting an answer or status.
I could navigate the knowledge map (dependencies and prerequisites).
The language used across explanations and UI labels was understandable.
